title: Charlie’s Chalk Dust | Pacha Mama | Blood Orange Banana Gooseberry 60ml
description:
Charlie’s Chalk Dust | Pacha Mama | Blood Orange Banana Gooseberry 60ml
Pacha Mama Blood Orange Banana Gooseberry:
Rich, Red Blood Orange Mango highlights are combined with banana notes and just a hint of wild gooseberries. A lightly tart and sweet vape juice flavor combination that explodes with flavors on different levels.
Pacha Mama E Juices come at 0 MG Nicotine Level and is perfect for all-day vaping.
This E-Liquid line from Charlie’s Chalk Dust is not to be missed. Also, check out other e juice flavours from Pacha Mama Salts SubOhm.
Flavour Profile
: Blood Orange, Banana, Gooseberry
VG/PG
: 80/20
Nicotine
: 0MG
Bottle Size
: 60ml
